app.name: Shopify Sidekick
app.description: Shopify's AI assistant for merchants that answers questions, builds Shopify Flow automations and custom apps, and runs store tasks.

observations.note: Stated on Shopify's Q3 2026 earnings call (Nov 3, 2026): 'From the second to the third quarter, merchant conversations rose 14%, while cost per conversation fell 28% and total Sidekick cost declined 18%.' Growth in merchant conversations with Sidekick, quarter over quarter (91 days). The snippet gives no period end date, so this is dated to the Nov 3 announcement. Another search summary of Q3 coverage (results incl. https://ppc.land/shopify-revenue-gains-32-to-3-7bn-as-ai-referred-orders-rise-3-3x/ and https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/shopify-inc-shop-q3-2026-210823609.html) gave the same figure: 'merchant conversations with Sidekick ... increased 14% quarter-over-quarter while cost per conversation fell 28%.' Company-stated, unaudited. Search-result snippets only; no page was read (WebFetch got ENOTFOUND for sec.gov, fool.com and ppc.land).
